$comment: Maintainer review scores for hooks-catalog.json, out of 100. Rubric: .bb/skills/review-hook/references/scoring.md. After scoring, run npm run scores -- --stamp <id> and npm run readme.

issues: {{error|500}} is always empty on turn.failed, whose payload has errorInfo {category, httpStatusCode, providerCode} and no error text.
severity is free text; anything but critical, error, warning or info makes PagerDuty reject the event.
PLAUSIBLE: Teams Workflows webhook URLs expect an Adaptive Card; a plain {"text"} body can be accepted without posting.

deductions.reason: Any #n in a thread title picks the issue ("Try approach #2" posts the thread's output to issue 2).
Comments on every turn (thread.idle), not once when the thread finishes as the summary says.

issues: The greedy sed takes the last #n in the title, not the first as the description says.

deductions.reason: Archives every thread after every turn unless the user adds a title filter; the scope isn't enforced, and archiving cascades to child threads.
BB's provider-retry already queues the same prompt for when the window opens, so the work runs twice in the same workspace.

issues: bb thread history omits a thread's spawn prompt, so a thread that fails on its first turn gets no failover.
PLAUSIBLE: the spawned child's completion starts a parent turn; while the provider is still rate limited that turn fails again and spawns another child.

deductions.reason: At most one continue per thread every two minutes, but no total cap: persistent capacity errors keep it going indefinitely.
Reads the whole thread log (bb thread log --all) on every failed turn, because the payload never contains the message it looks for; errorInfo.category == "overloaded" is already in the payload.

issues: bb= is only set inside the if branch; when the payload check matches, "$bb" thread tell runs as "" and exits 127.
Sends a "continue" message instead of bb thread retry, which resumes the failed turn properly.

deductions.reason: A credential guard that fails open: with no onError, a timeout or exhausted gate budget lets a matching message through. Set "onError": "reject".

issues: Blocks everyday kebab-case text: sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,} matches "task-list-item-renderer-component" (prefix \b to fix).
Misses fine-grained GitHub tokens (github_pat_) and gho_, ghs_ and ghu_ tokens.

deductions.reason: The user-supplied pattern is passed to grep without -e, so a pattern starting with - is read as an option.

issues: Also rejects the first message of threads started by agents, agent teams, playbooks and other hooks; exempt initiator != user.
Only sees the first 1000 characters of the message (BB_MESSAGE_TEXT).

deductions.reason: The endpoint URL isn't secret: true, but Zapier, n8n and similar webhook URLs are capability URLs, and it's stored in plain text in the hook.
The log file grows without limit or rotation.

issues: A path like ~/bb-events.jsonl is single-quoted by the renderer, so ~ doesn't expand and the write fails.

deductions.reason: Loops: the spawned child's completion sends the parent a child-completed message, whose turn fires thread.idle and spawns another child. The BB_PARENT_THREAD_ID guard only stops the child.
Spawns an agent thread after every turn of every top-level thread unless the user adds a filter.
Loops: the reviewer's completion sends the parent a child-completed message, whose turn fires thread.idle and spawns another reviewer. The BB_PARENT_THREAD_ID guard only stops the child.
Spawns a reviewer thread after every turn of every top-level thread unless the user adds a filter.
A guardrail that fails open: with no onError, a timeout or exhausted gate budget lets a matching message through. Set "onError": "reject".

issues: A window that crosses midnight (start 22, end 6) never opens, so matching messages are held forever.
